countermeasure_templates.name: ATM forensic-grade CCTV with 30-day retention
countermeasure_templates.description: Overt forensic-grade CCTV covering the ATM face (fascia, keypad, card slot, cash shutter) with ≥30-day retention and tamper-evident storage.

countermeasure_templates.name: ATM top-box intrusion sensor
countermeasure_templates.description: Lid/top-box intrusion sensor that fires silent alarm and locks the dispenser on opening attempt — primary countermeasure against black-box jackpotting.

countermeasure_templates.name: Gas-detection and suppression inside ATM safe
countermeasure_templates.description: In-safe hydrocarbon sensor with active inerting / suppression, triggered on threshold to prevent oxy-acetylene and explosive-gas breaches.

countermeasure_templates.name: IBNS cash-staining (ATM cassettes)
countermeasure_templates.description: Intelligent banknote neutralisation system inside cash cassettes — triggered by tilt/explosion/unauthorised-open events to render notes unusable.

countermeasure_templates.name: Anti-ramming bollards / Jersey barriers at ATM kerb
countermeasure_templates.description: K12/PAS-68 bollards or Jersey barriers in front of through-the-wall ATMs to prevent vehicle ram-raid extraction.

countermeasure_templates.name: Anti-skimming insert with motorised card reader
countermeasure_templates.description: Motorised DIP/insert card reader with active anti-skimming (jitter + physical blocker) and overlay-detection on fascia.

countermeasure_templates.name: Badge access with anti-tailgate detection
countermeasure_templates.description: Card/biometric access to staff areas backed by optical or LIDAR tailgate detection; alarm and CCTV bookmark on violation.

countermeasure_templates.name: Silent duress / panic alarm at teller positions
countermeasure_templates.description: Hidden silent-alarm trigger under every teller station and at customer-facing reception, wired to a monitored ARC with ≤15-min response SLA.

countermeasure_templates.name: Ballistic-resistant teller screen (EN 1063 BR4)
countermeasure_templates.description: EN 1063 BR4+ ballistic glazing between teller and public counter, with cash-pass drawer and UL-listed interlock.

countermeasure_templates.name: Armed response SLA (≤15 min)
countermeasure_templates.description: Contracted armed-response service with 15-minute SLA to every branch, verified by quarterly silent drills and independent audit.

countermeasure_templates.name: UL 687 Class M vault rating
countermeasure_templates.description: Vault body/door meeting UL 687 Class M (120-minute tool + torch attack resistance) with manufacturer certificate on file.

countermeasure_templates.name: Vault mantrap with anti-passback
countermeasure_templates.description: Interlocked mantrap vestibule at vault entry enforcing anti-passback via dual-credential + weight sensor; CCTV bookmark on every cycle.

countermeasure_templates.name: Dual-control vault access procedure
countermeasure_templates.description: Two-person integrity rule for every vault entry: split knowledge, tamper-sealed key/combo envelopes, access log reviewed weekly.

countermeasure_templates.name: Time-delay lock on vault door
countermeasure_templates.description: Electronic time-delay lock (5–15 min) on primary vault door, defeatable only via dual-control override logged to audit trail.

countermeasure_templates.name: CIT IBNS with geofence + tamper activation
countermeasure_templates.description: Cash satchel/container IBNS triggered by geofence breach, unauthorised open, or duress key — renders contents unusable.

countermeasure_templates.name: Concealed GPS tracker (vehicle + satchel)
countermeasure_templates.description: Redundant concealed GPS trackers in CIT vehicle and cash satchel, monitored 24/7 by control room with geofence alerts.

countermeasure_templates.name: Dual-crew CIT operation
countermeasure_templates.description: All cash-in-transit runs staffed by two trained crew members, one remaining with vehicle; radio check-ins at each stop logged to ARC.

countermeasure_templates.name: Biometric mantrap at cage entry
countermeasure_templates.description: Two-factor (card + biometric) mantrap at data-centre cage entry with anti-tailgate sensor; logs every entry to immutable audit store.

countermeasure_templates.name: TIA-942 Tier III physical perimeter
countermeasure_templates.description: Outer perimeter meeting TIA-942 Tier III (layered fencing, HVM bollards, vehicle screening area) with verified compliance audit.

countermeasure_templates.name: Cage lock with audit trail + quarterly review
countermeasure_templates.description: Per-cage smart-lock producing tamper-evident open/close log; quarterly review of access log vs. authorised ticket list.

countermeasure_templates.name: Close protection team (principal + residence)
countermeasure_templates.description: Trained close-protection officers covering principal movements plus residence posts; 24/7 coverage with documented threat briefings.

countermeasure_templates.name: Varied route and timing protocol for principal
countermeasure_templates.description: Mandatory route/timing variation for principal's daily commute and public engagements; published only to need-to-know.

countermeasure_templates.name: Visitor escort and badge policy
countermeasure_templates.description: All non-employee visitors pre-registered, photo-badged at reception, and escorted at all times inside staff-only areas.

countermeasure_templates.name: Monitored intrusion alarm (EN 50131 Grade 3)
countermeasure_templates.description: EN 50131 Grade 3 monitored intrusion detection covering perimeter doors, windows and sensitive rooms; ARC-signalled with response SLA.

countermeasure_templates.name: Clean-desk + privacy-filter policy
countermeasure_templates.description: Enforced clean-desk policy, privacy filters on every screen, and secure-shred bins; quarterly walk-through audit by security officer.
